lines.zh: 翅膀一开一合，我飘过去
lines.en: My wings open and close as I drift.

lines.zh: 翅膀上那点红，是节日的色
lines.en: The red on my wings is the holiday color.
I cross the wood, looking for flowers.
Not fast, and my wings are large.
One pass and I'm dusted with pollen.
I rest on a daisy, only briefly.

lines.zh: 翼展很大，飞起来沙沙响
lines.en: My wingspan is broad; they rustle in flight.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间空地划过去
lines.en: I trace a line through the forest clearing.

lines.zh: 阳光照透翅膀，能看到纹
lines.en: Sun through my wings shows the pattern.
I rise a little to clear the grass.
Another patch of flowers; I settle.
My flight is unsteady; a strong wind sets me off.

lines.zh: 这趟带回去的东西，够用了
lines.en: What I carry back will do.
I have only so many days to fly.
One circle, and there are more flowers.

lines.zh: 我在花上停着，翅膀慢慢合
lines.en: I rest on a flower, wings folding slowly.
Pollen falls on my legs.

lines.zh: 春天一样的味道，虽然天不冷
lines.en: It smells like spring here.

lines.zh: 我活得不久，所以一直在飞
lines.en: I don't live long, so I keep flying.

lines.zh: 大翅膀收起来很占地方
lines.en: Folded, these big wings take space.
The flower's center is a little sweet.
The flower beside is still closed.

lines.zh: 我停了一会儿，又想起来该走了
lines.en: I rested a while, then remembered to go.
The wind makes my wings tremble.

lines.zh: 林子安静的时候，只有我在振翅
lines.en: When the wood is quiet, only my wings sound.

lines.zh: 这一朵谢了，就换下一朵
lines.en: This one's spent; on to the next.

lines.zh: 你在看一只很大的蝴蝶
lines.en: You're looking at a very large butterfly.
Don't cup your hands over me.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的红你看见了吗
lines.en: See the red on my wings?

lines.zh: 我停在你肩头上一会儿
lines.en: I'll rest on your shoulder a moment.
I can't fly much longer.
Don't swing that net; it would hurt me.
You don't smell like flowers.
Let some light through.

lines.zh: 我这样看着你，你就懂了
lines.en: I look at you like this; that should be enough.
I only come out in daylight.
A corner of my wing is torn.
A patch of scales came off.
I dropped to the ground.
With this, I can't fly long.
I try to rise again.
My wings are shaking badly.
I lie still on the flower.
There wasn't much time anyway.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被踩出一道折痕。
lines.en: A crease is pressed into my wing.
Flowers; I only want flowers.
Is that a daisy?
Raise the flower and I'll climb on.
That's too far; I can't reach.
I don't take honey, only nectar.
Set it down and keep still; I'll come.
Faint sweetness, but there.
I know this flower.
You can coax me with this.
Closer, I can't smell it clearly.
Startled, I take off.
Scale dust rubs onto your hand.
My wings are thin; one touch tears them.
I circled your hand once.
Don't swat; that isn't wind.
One bump and I fly crooked.
I passed by your ear.
You move too fast.
Half a step back, I'm taking off.
I don't have long.
Another red-winged one is over there.
We circle over the flowers.
Wing to wing, that's enough.
Eggs go on the leaves.
What happens after, I'm not sure.
Don't disturb us.
This flight will use me up.
The light up there is just right.
Neither of us lives long.
I gather pollen on my legs.
I can't pick things off the ground.
This bit of pollen, I'll carry back.
I take a little from the flower's center.

lines.zh: 黏在我腿上的，都是宝贝
lines.en: What sticks to my legs is treasure.
I don't want to carry anything else.
A flower fell; I'll go see.
I can't carry anything heavy.
I like this color.
A touch is enough.
There's a patch of flowers ahead.
I see it, white.
Right direction.
This one's bigger than the last.
I fly lower.
Nothing's moving over there.
The flower's center is bright.
That one.
The wind pushed me along.
Right in front of me.
I ease down slowly.
Wings flat, slowing.
The flower sways; I wait.
Almost there.
Legs must reach out.
The wind came again.
This flower is large enough.
I adjusted my angle.
Nearly there.
Land lightly.
I can only bump into you.
My wings hit your face.
A little scale dust, harmless.
I have no strength.
That wasn't an attack, just passing.
I was startled.
I fly off.
One touch and I scatter.
I can't fight.
I only want to get back to the flower.

lines.zh: 一只大蝴蝶从树影里出来
lines.en: A large butterfly comes out of the shade.
The red on the wings stands out.
The flowers in the wood have opened.
I fly over from the flower patch.
The daylight is just right.
I rested on the bark a moment.
There's a nectar source in this forest.
My wings open for the first time.
Pollen's already on me.
Light ahead; I'll head there.
Fire curled the edge of my wings.
I fell into the grass and can't right myself.
Wet wings and I can't fly.
The blast blew me far.
Something pierced my wing.

lines.zh: 法术打来，翅膀上的纹路乱了
lines.en: The spell hit and my wing pattern blurred.

lines.zh: 我吸不到花，翅膀越来越沉
lines.en: No nectar, and my wings get heavier.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整只都白了
lines.en: Lightning flashed and I went white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有花，也没有风
lines.en: No flowers in the void, and no wind.
